Title: Business Analyst
Description: About PayJoy PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success. Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system. Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life. PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth. This role We are looking for a Collections Technical Analyst to drive data accuracy, system integrations, and process automation within our Collections tech stack. This role will be responsible for managing data ingestion into Customer.io, handling agent assignment logic and workflow maintenance, owning and maintaining 15+ performance dashboards, and enabling deeper segment analysis and experimentation. The ideal candidate will also support connectivity with external data sources (EDC), and will be comfortable launching and iterating on collections tools designed to improve portfolio recovery. This position is critical in translating data into actionable insights that drive collections efficiency and recovery outcomes. Our primary tools include Hex, SQL, and Python. Key Responsibilities Data Ingestion & Customer.io Management: Design and maintain reliable data ingestion pipelines that feed customer and account data into Customer.io. Ensure data quality and consistency across ingestion flows using SQL and Python. Monitor pipeline health and proactively resolve data discrepancies or failures. Collaborate with engineering and data teams to expand and improve data sources feeding into collections workflows. Agent Assignment & Workflow Maintenance Own and manage the collections agent assignment logic, ensuring accounts are correctly distributed based on defined rules and performance criteria. Maintain and update assignment workflows as team structure, strategies, or segmentation evolves. Automate assignment processes to reduce manual overhead and increase operational efficiency. Partner with collections operations to align assignment logic with business priorities and capacity planning. Dashboard Ownership & Reporting Build, maintain, and optimize 15+ collections performance dashboards in Hex using SQL. Ensure data accuracy and reliability across all dashboards by implementing validation checks and data quality processes. Deliver insights that help collections leadership make informed decisions on recovery strategies, agent performance, and portfolio health. Respond to ad hoc reporting requests and iterate on dashboards as business needs evolve. Segment Analysis & Experimentation Conduct in-depth analysis of customer segments to identify recovery patterns, risk profiles, and opportunities for targeted collections strategies. Design and execute A/B tests and experiments to measure the impact of new collections approaches on recovery rates. Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for the collections team. Support the continuous improvement of segmentation models by incorporating behavioral, payment, and risk data. EDC Integration & External Data Connectivity Establish and maintain data connections with EDC and other external data providers relevant to collections operations. Ensure external data sources are properly ingested, validated, and available for analysis and modeling. Work with cross-functional teams to identify new external data opportunities that can improve collections outcomes. Document integration workflows and data dictionaries to ensure operational continuity. Collections Tools & Portfolio Recovery Design, launch, and iterate on data-driven collections tools (e.g., propensity models, contact prioritization logic, automated treatment triggers) aimed at improving portfolio recovery. Monitor tool performance post-launch and make data-backed adjustments to maximize recovery impact. Identify inefficiencies in current collections processes and propose technical solutions to address them. Stay up to date with industry best practices in collections technology and apply relevant innovations to the team’s toolset. Cross-functional Collaboration Work with internal and external areas to ensure data consistency across departments. Support collections agents and team leads with training on dashboards, reports, and automated processes. Communicate technical findings in a business-friendly language for non-technical stakeholders. Collaborate with the risk, product, and engineering teams to align collections data initiatives with broader company goals. Qualifications Technical Skills & Tools: Mandatory: SQL (advanced), Python, Hex (or equivalent data notebook/BI tools), data ingestion and pipeline management. Experience with Customer.io or similar CRM/marketing automation platforms used for collections or customer engagement. Proficiency in data visualization and ability to build and maintain dashboards for operational teams. Familiarity with API integrations and connecting to external data sources. Experience designing and running A/B tests or controlled experiments in a data-driven environment. Desirable But Not Essential Knowledge of collections, credit risk, or lending operations. Experience with EDC or similar external credit data providers. Familiarity with machine learning or statistical modeling for propensity scoring or segmentation. Experience working in Fintech, financial services, or similar data-driven industries. Specific Knowledge Experience in Collections Operations, Credit Risk, or Business Intelligence roles. Strong understanding of portfolio management, delinquency tracking, and recovery strategies. Ability to independently scope, build, and deploy analytical tools with minimal supervision. Expected Results From This Role Reliable and automated data pipelines feeding Customer.io with up-to-date and accurate customer information. Reduced manual workload through automated assignment logic and streamlined collections workflows. Improved decision-making through well-maintained, accurate, and actionable dashboards (15+). Measurable improvement in portfolio recovery rates driven by data-backed tools and experimentation. Stronger connectivity with external data sources (EDC) enabling richer segment analysis and treatment strategies. Soft Skills Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into business decisions. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to proactively identify and address operational gaps. Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams. Strong ownership mentality — comfortable managing multiple workstreams and delivering results independently. Benefits 100% Company-funded Health and dental and vision discount plan for employees and immediate family members. Life insurance. Phone finance, Headphone, home office equipment and wellness perks. 30 days of Christmas bonus 20 days paid Vacation 50% Vacation premium $2,000 MXN monthly grocery coupons $2,000 USD annual Co-working Travel perk $2,000 USD annual Professional Development perk Catered lunches PayJoy is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and we welcome and encourage people of all backgrounds. Title: Software Development Engineer, LATECH and GIS
Description: Description Amazon brings buyers and sellers together. Our retail customers depend on us to give them access to every product at the best possible price. Our sellers depend on us to give them a platform to launch their business into every home and marketplace. Making this happen is the mission of every engineer on the LATECH and GIS team. We’re looking for leaders and trailblazers who aren’t afraid of tackling massive scale, layered complexity, and ambiguous requirements. If you want to create exciting new features, bringing unique experiences and value to our customers, then we want to talk to you. If you want to work on the fulfillment technologies that bring increased selection and a premier delivery experience across all of Latin America, we want to talk to you. If you want to work on internet scale to positively touch millions of customers’ experiences then we want to talk to you! We’re the LATECH and GIS development team. We aim to leverage US inventory to unlock greater selection, lower prices, and faster delivery for our customers in Mexico and Brazil. We improve the shopping and buying experience for Latin American customers and business, and we do all this while ensuring our designs adhere to legal and tax compliance in some of the most complicated tax authorities in the world. We’re looking for engineers who are passionate about writing code and who love to build distributed systems that are transactional, scalable, high throughput, fault tolerant and always available. We’re looking for engineers who are able to design and develop beautiful front-end UI as well as the massively scalable backend services to support it. We’re seeking engineers who are comfortable driving the end to end solution and who can do so in an autonomous and creative manner. Key job responsibilities We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our growing team of developers in Mexico. On our team, you will work on many highly available Tier-1 services, and will be at the forefront of enabling experiences tailor-made for our 300 million plus customers. You will be tasked to think big and find new ways on how we can more efficiently expand services in LatAm, and work daily with massively scalable distributed systems processing hundreds of billions of requests a day. You will be responsible for the design, development, test, and deployment of these services, at the same upholding the bar for OE (operational excellence). Candidates will need to think outside the box to quickly come up with innovative solutions to problems that are unique to Amazon. A successful candidate will have an established background in developing real time scalable systems, a strong technical ability, great communication skills, and a motivation to achieve results in a fast paced environment. A day in the life In a typical day you will be tasked with owning and leading the investigation and architecture for expanding Amazon Retail features to LatAm. You will need to find ways to optimize or automate those features, or build relevant tooling. You will then be writing the code for those features and co-ordinating with engineers from other teams to deploy your code in front of customers in production. As a Software Development Engineer you will work developing and reviewing code, creating design reviews and participating in operational reviews. And if you happen to go into the office, you might be tasked with a friendly game of table tennis. About The Team The Amazon International Expansion team in Mexico is small group (20 people primarily in Mexico City) of experienced Amazonians who tackle complex/ambiguous problems everyday. We keep our on-call load low, so we can focus on solving bigger picture problems. We are a social group and generally organize a team event at least once per month. Recent activities in Mexico include bowling, weekly soccer games, and hiking on La Marquesa. Inclusive team culture At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust Mentorship& Career Growth Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional. Work Life Balance We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. Basic Qualifications 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language Preferred Qualifications 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
